note: Story packs seed ordinary stories into a project's story map (DEC-037). template: true only where the aludel-web-v1 scaffold really builds the story today; everything else becomes work.

accounts.label: Accounts
accounts.summary: Sign up, sign in and manage an account.

stories.title: Someone can sign up with email and password

acceptance.given: a visitor on the sign-in page
acceptance.when: they enter a name, email and a password of 8+ characters
acceptance.then: an account exists and they are signed in

stories.title: Someone can sign in

acceptance.when: they enter their email and password
acceptance.then: they are signed in and see their name in the header

stories.title: Someone can sign out

acceptance.then: they are signed out and the header offers Sign in

stories.title: Someone can reset a forgotten password
clarifications: Needs an email delivery provider (Platform › Connections)

stories.title: Someone can change their name and password

messaging.label: Messaging
messaging.summary: People message each other one to one.

stories.title: Someone can start a conversation from [a record in this app]
clarifications: Which record do conversations start from (a product, a profile, a listing)?

stories.title: Someone can see their conversations, with unread counts
Someone can read and reply in a conversation
Someone is notified of new messages
Someone can block another person

search.label: Search
search.summary: Find things by keyword and narrow the results.

stories.title: Someone can search by keyword
clarifications: What can be searched (names, descriptions, categories)?

stories.title: Someone can filter the results
Someone can see their recent searches

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.summary: Tell people what needs their attention.

stories.title: Someone can see what needs their attention
Someone can choose what they are notified about

profiles.label: Profiles
profiles.summary: Each person has a public profile.

stories.title: Someone can view another person's profile
Someone can edit their public profile
Someone can attach a photo
Someone can remove something they uploaded

payments.label: Payments
payments.summary: Take payments (a provider is connected later).

stories.title: Someone can pay for [something in this app]
clarifications: What is being paid for, and which payment provider?

stories.title: Someone can see their payment history

admin.label: Admin area
admin.summary: A private area for running the app.

stories.title: An admin can review and remove reported content
An admin can manage people's accounts
